speaker: will_kemp
text: Is it the slippers now. The play is done. I am still in my own shoes.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Thursday. Today the stage is not yours. The promise was Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You heard it this morning. Thursday, after the play. Not this afternoon.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Then I will keep them clean. A man hears of a wise man over the water and is asked to dance on top of it. I am not dancing on a rumour.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The Wise Man is their bill. I am not going. The duke is done for today. The dance is not this afternoon.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Go home, both of you. I am not teaching a jig over a cleared stage.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Thursday, then. I will be loud when it is mine. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. I am for the stair, and a page that is not a shoe.
